response.justification: The candidate is an experienced generalist with genuine geospatial background (founding GISCollective, Green Map GIS work, FOSS4G talk) and proven low-latency systems experience handling millions of requests per second at Dunnhumby. However, that systems work was in DLang rather than the required modern C++ or Rust, his professional C++ exposure is brief and dated (2014–2015), and he has no direct experience with routing engines, tiling pipelines, or navigation guidance systems. Recent roles are predominantly TypeScript/Node full-stack work, making the fit uncertain for a C++-centric routing data pipeline role, though his adaptability and geospatial domain interest keep him worth a possible conversation.
strengths: Founder-level geospatial experience (GISCollective, Green Map) with real-world map data users
Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems work (async I/O, caching, fibers) at Dunnhumby
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, and Linux/DevOps fluency
concerns: No substantial recent modern C++ or any Rust experience; systems work was in DLang
No direct routing, navigation guidance, or map-tiling pipeline experience
Recent roles (2020–present) are mostly TypeScript/Node full-stack, drifting from systems engineering
